regions.name: Rural Areas
regions.where: Rural areas nationwide (the locator map shades all of Venezuela)
regions.notes: Rainy Season May-Nov; lean box Jun-Aug. 'Winter' (invierno) = rainy-season cycle, 'Summer' (verano) = dry-season cycle; Summer crops are sown Oct-Dec at the tail of the rains and harvested Feb-Apr, so they are linked to no rainy season. Coffee and sugar cane harvest is drawn as Oct-Dec plus Jan-Mar with open (square) ends at the year edge, one season. Potato harvest runs mid-Mar to just short of mid-Apr (April ~45% covered, so not counted); potato land prep mid-Oct to mid-Nov, planting mid-Nov to Dec. The Summer vegetable harvest is drawn in June.

regions.name: Urban Areas
regions.where: Urban areas nationwide (Caracas and other cities); no locator map for this block
regions.notes: Urban block has no rainy shading, harvest, planting or lean box. Rows: informal labour/petty trade (higher demand Nov-Dec), self-employment (higher demand Sep-Dec), salaried employment year-round, end-of-year double salaries (Oct-Jan), remittances (high mid-Nov to Dec), high expenditure periods (Christmas Dec-Jan, Carnival mid-Feb to mid-Mar, school expenses Oct).

assign.method: Rural/urban blocks are livelihood types, not areas; every state mixes both. States were mapped to rural (the agricultural calendar covers their land), and only Distrito Capital and La Guaira (part of the Caracas urban area) to urban.

transcriber_notes: Rainy, lean and crop edges fall on month boundaries except the potato harvest (mid-Mar to ~45% of Apr, so April not counted: Mar only) and potato land prep/planting (split at mid-Nov). The rural/urban split cannot be mapped to states from the image; heavily urbanised states (Miranda, Carabobo, Aragua, Zulia, Lara, Nueva Esparta) kept rural with medium/low confidence. The urban region has empty rainy/harvest/lean/planting lists because the image draws none for it.
